revision: Seen-selected query-only score correction on the existing raw-sequence adapter; no retraining
source_checkpoint: Existing five-epoch R_raw_sequence strict-inner checkpoint per fold; exact checkpoint copied into the new local run directory and SHA-256 recorded.
uncorrected_score: Existing raw-sequence video-query adapter score from the successful Idea 05 run.
query_prior_score: Existing training-only query logistic-regression score (C=0.1) computed from inner-train query features; reused per row from the validated original prediction artifact.
selection: Maximize pooled AUROC on inner Seen validation, earliest lambda tie. Novel-dev is read only after lambda is fixed.
primary_comparison: Corrected versus uncorrected raw-sequence scores on identical rows/checkpoint.
required_controls: natural Seen and Novel pooled AUROC and descriptive Seen−Novel gap
same-query cross-video PairAcc/AUROC with connected query-video component bootstrap
same-video source-linked PairAcc with video-cluster bootstrap
fresh raw-video derangement before adapter interaction and scoring; evaluate corrected and uncorrected scores with labels retained only as dependence diagnostic
strict-inner baseline AUROC, frozen localization, parameter count and evaluation/shuffle cost
interpretation_guard: Subtracting a query-only score is score comparability calibration. If conditional rankings do not improve, do not call it stronger video-query compatibility even if pooled AUROC improves.
